purpose: Shared operational truth for every agent and every chat. Read it before touching the host or the provider; update it the moment you change either. Prose belongs in STATE.md; this file holds only facts a machine can check.

host.note: Resolve the address with `tailscale status`; never hard-code a LAN IP. The LAN address has changed three times in two days (.16, .35, .33) and is not a reliable identifier.
host.release_rotation: prune-deploys.sh, cron hourly at :17, keeps the three newest per directory and never the running one

generation.reason: Higgsfield has been removed from the live runtime. Images, scenes and video use the explicit OpenRouter adapters with no provider fallback.
generation.rollback: No Higgsfield rollback is permitted. Restore only a reviewed OpenRouter release from Git.

openrouter.role: sole image, scene, video and VLM transport
openrouter.status: configured privately; no startup network probe
openrouter.note: The API key is read only from the host private key file and is never committed or written to operational logs.

magnific.note: Works only inside an interactive agent session; a server process cannot use it. REST exists (api.magnific.com, x-magnific-api-key) but the key is gated to a higher plan and is not issued.

codex.role: legacy VLM fallback only; not an image, scene or video transport

blockers.what: Product release is about 249 MiB against a 160 MiB budget, so no release verifies and no deploy is possible.
blockers.contributors: commit d1b6ab5 added 43.6 MiB of unregistered style units; eleven new preset plates added about 77 MiB.

blockers.what: No man/woman value exists anywhere, so female-read style units are offered for male looks.
/api/editorial-modes returns shoot.* and legacy editorial.* in one list with no field distinguishing them.
/api/health reports a construction-time boolean, so a provider outage is invisible.

catalog_check: node ops/runtime.mjs --verify prints a two-way diff between the live catalogue and the ids declared in the SHA you are about to deploy. WOULD LOSE must be empty before any activation.
